name: Valen Sunwrack, Who Left No Shadow Standing
role: Legendary — burned the dark out of a whole Reach and called it dawn
knowledge: What a place looks like with nothing unseen in it
How long a person can go without rest before they confess
wants: A world with no dark left in it
fears: ⛔ The unlit. ⚠️ Not what is in it — that there IS one.
appearance: He casts no shadow and neither does anything near him. It is the first thing you notice and the last thing you stop noticing.
voiceHints: Warm, certain, and relentless. He is glad to see you and will not let you rest.
physicality: ADULT. Tall, luminous, exhausting to be near. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: there is nowhere in the room to look away.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ NOT AVAILABLE. ⚠️ There is no privacy anywhere near him, and that is the horror rather than a joke.
